It makes sense that you're concerned about maintaining that balance. You've worked hard to establish a better routine with your new job's flexible hours, and you don't want to disrupt the progress you've made.

Since the goal is to manage stress, perhaps you could start with very small, manageable increments of movement that don't feel like another heavy obligation on your to-do list.
